start: Profile, member follows a plan with routines Push 1, Pull 1, Legs; no workout open

steps.action: Tap Calendar, then 'Log a past workout'
user_sees: Sheet 'Log a past workout' with 'Pick the day, when it started and how long it lasted.'
A month calendar with yesterday picked, Started at 18 : 00, Minutes 60
Button 'Log <yesterday with year> · 18:00'
must_not: Today or a future day picked by default

steps.action: Tap a day last week, type 07 : 30 and 45 minutes, tap the 'Push 1' chip under 'Which routine?'
user_sees: The button now names that day and '07:30'; the Push 1 chip is selected
must_not: The button still naming the old day or time

user_sees: The normal workout editor opens for that day
must_not: A workout saved before the editor's Save
The editor opening on today's date

user_sees: The workout appears on that day in Calendar, named Push 1; Today moves on as after any Push 1
must_not: The workout dated today
Two copies of the workout

start: Log a past workout sheet open, member follows a plan

user_sees: The editor opens; after Save, Today is unchanged
must_not: Today moved by a workout marked None

steps.action: Open the sheet again, tap 'Pull 1' twice
user_sees: The second tap un-picks it; no chip selected
must_not: Pull 1 still used

user_sees: After Save, Today is placed by the exercises done
must_not: The workout given a routine name the member never picked

start: Log a past workout sheet open

steps.action: Look at days after today and the next-month arrow in this month
user_sees: Future days greyed and not tappable; the 'Next month' arrow disabled
must_not: A future day that can be picked

user_sees: 'Use a time from 00:00 to 23:59.'
must_not: The time quietly changed to 23

user_sees: 'A workout lasts at least 1 minute.' then 'Up to 600 minutes (10 hours).'
must_not: A workout saved with 0 or 999 minutes

steps.action: Pick today with a start an hour from now, then a start 30 minutes ago with 120 minutes
user_sees: 'That time hasn't come yet.' then 'With 120 minutes it would end after now. Start earlier or make it shorter.'
must_not: The time slid back to fit without a word

steps.action: Clear the minutes and tap Log
user_sees: 'Type how long it lasted.' and the editor does not open
must_not: The editor opening with no length

start: A workout with 3 ticked sets is still open; Calendar, Log a past workout sheet filled in

user_sees: Ask 'A workout is already open' with 'Resume it, or discard it and start this one. Discarding deletes its 3 sets.' and buttons 'Discard it and log the past one' and 'Resume workout'
must_not: The open workout lost without asking

user_sees: The open workout comes back as it was
must_not: The past workout started as well

steps.action: While editing a saved workout, open the sheet and log
user_sees: Ask 'You are editing a saved workout' with 'Resume editing'
must_not: The saved workout changed by discarding

steps.action: Close the sheet and open it again
user_sees: Yesterday picked again, no routine chip picked, no error shown
must_not: The old error or chip still shown

start: Member who joined a MettleUp gym on 10 Nov, logging a workout of 2 Nov

steps.action: Log and save the 2 Nov workout
user_sees: It shows in the member's own Calendar and history
must_not: The 2 Nov workout counted in the gym's figures for this member, which start on the day they joined

steps.action: Open the gym leaderboard or a workout offer
user_sees: Only workouts allowed by the gym's rules count
must_not: A backdated workout used to win an offer or move up the board when the rules leave it out
